title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
english: Israel is preparing for a highly significant and competitive general election that reveals deep political fractures within the nation. Recent polls show an extremely close race between Benjamin Netanyahu’s party and the centrist opposition led by newcomer Gadi Eisenkot. With large numbers of citizens traveling home to vote and massive public demonstrations taking place, the outcome remains highly uncertain and critical for the country's future.

title: Bulgaria election heads to a run-off amid low voter turnout
english: Bulgaria's presidential election is moving to a second round after no candidate secured enough votes in the initial contest, which was marked by very low voter participation. Incumbent President Iliana Iotova will compete against former caretaker Prime Minister Andrey Gyurov on November 1. The campaign focused on pressing challenges including high inflation, energy costs, and regional security concerns related to the war in Ukraine.

english: Real Madrid secured a 2-1 victory over Barcelona at Camp Nou, handing the league leaders their first domestic defeat of the season. title: US Attorney General Todd Blanche defends Alaska Senate election lawsuit
english: US Attorney General Todd Blanche is defending a Department of Justice lawsuit that aims to block the certification of Alaska's tight Senate race. The legal challenge addresses concerns that a candidate with a similar name to the Republican incumbent is being used to confuse voters and influence the election outcome. While the administration argues it is protecting election integrity, the lawsuit has drawn bipartisan criticism over claims that it is politically motivated to prevent a Democratic victory.

title: The Error in Tsmido’s Trial and Error
english: Various opposing political and armed groups in Ethiopia, including the TPLF, Fano, and OLA, are forming an unlikely coalition with the sole purpose of challenging Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. While these groups share a common enemy, they lack a unified vision for the country’s future and hold deeply conflicting views on core issues like federalism and territorial integrity. This risky strategy could lead to state collapse or further fragmentation, as the groups involved have vastly different goals and would likely struggle to cooperate once the current government is removed.

title: Kenya bus crash kills at least 24 as government vows road safety crackdown
english: A tragic bus accident involving mourners on the Nairobi-Mombasa highway has resulted in at least 24 deaths and dozens of injuries. The collision occurred when a bus traveling from a funeral struck a truck, with authorities suspecting dangerous overtaking as a possible cause. Following this disaster and another recent deadly crash, the Kenyan government has pledged to conduct stricter road safety inspections.

title: Israeli settler group submits proposals for new Jewish settlement in Sheikh Jarrah neighbourhood
english: An Israeli settler group has formally requested permission to construct a new housing complex containing 122 units on the former site of the Shepherd Hotel in Sheikh Jarrah, East Jerusalem. This proposal, which marks the organization's first project in the neighborhood, is scheduled for a local planning hearing on November 11. Meanwhile, Israeli military operations in Hebron have resulted in numerous arrests, the displacement of over 2,200 residents, and the temporary seizure of private homes for use as military outposts.

oromo: Gareen gahuulota Israa'el tokko naannoo Seek Jaaraa kan gara baha Yerusaalemitti argamu keessatti mana jireenyaa 122 ijaaruuf hayyama gaafateera. Yeroo walfakkaatuus, waraanni Israa'el magaalaa Heebroon keessatti tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiruun namoonni 2,200 ol ta'an buqqa'anii jiru, namoonni hedduun hidhamaniiru, akkasumas manneen namoota dhuunfaa buufata waraanaa godhataniiru.

title: Netanyahu warns of second Holocaust if he loses Israeli elections
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently shared a post on social media warning that losing the upcoming elections could lead to a second Holocaust. He used an AI-generated image of a nuclear explosion to emphasize the potential threat from Iran's nuclear program. Netanyahu argued that only he is capable of neutralizing this existential danger and urged voters to prioritize national security over political disagreements.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በመጪው ምርጫ ከተሸነፉ ሀገሪቱ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሆሎኮስት አደጋ ሊገጥማት እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ስጋቱን ለማጉላትም በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ የተሰራ የኒውክሌር ፍንዳታ ምስል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለቀዋል። ኔታንያሁ ይህንን አደጋ መቋቋም የሚችለው እሳቸው ብቻ እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ፣ መራጮች ከፖለቲካዊ ጥላቻ ይልቅ ለሀገራዊ ደህንነት ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministira Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahu filannoo dhufu irratti injifataman biyyattiin miidhaa 'Holocaust' lammaffaaf saaxilamuu dandeessi jechuun akeekkachiisan. Balaa kana ibsuufis suuraa boombii niwuukilaraa kan madaala sammuu namaa (AI) fayyadamuun qophaa'e marsariitii hawaasummaa irratti gadhiisaniiru. title: Israeli forces detain 20 Palestinians during searches in besieged Hebron
english: Israeli military forces have arrested at least 20 Palestinians during widespread raids throughout the city of Hebron and surrounding towns in the West Bank. These ongoing security operations have caused significant disruption, leading to the displacement of over 2,200 residents from their homes. Reports indicate that soldiers searched numerous properties and allegedly mistreated civilians while carrying out the detentions.

oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Heebroon fi naannawa ishee keessatti adeemsisaa jiran kanaan namoota Palestinoota 20 ol ta'an to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Hojiin nageenyaa kun uummata 2,200 ol ta'u manneen isaaniirraa akka buqqa'an taasiseera. Waraanni sun manneen jireenyaa hedduu sakatta'uudhaan fi namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa geessisuudhaan kanneen to'annaa jala oolchan ta'uun gabaafameera.

title: Tehran strikes Iranian Kurdish base in Iraq with drones, report says
english: Iranian military forces recently launched drone strikes against a base used by an Iranian Kurdish opposition group located in northern Iraq. The Revolutionary Guards targeted the site, which is associated with the Komala militant organization, as part of an ongoing campaign against such groups. Iran has frequently conducted similar operations in Iraq's Kurdistan region since earlier this year.

oromo: Humnoonni waraana Iraan naannoo Kurdiistaan biyya Iraaq keessatti buufata garee mormituu Kurdii Iraan irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun raawwataniiru. Humnoonni tiksaa jijjiramaa Iraan (Revolutionary Guards) haleellaa kana kan raawwatan garee lolaa 'Komala' irratti yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii gareewwan kana irratti fudhatamu keessaa isa tokko. Iraan waggaa kana keessa erga waraanni ka’ee jalqabee naannoo Kurdiistaan Iraaq keessatti bakkeewwan gareewwan kanaa irratti yeroo hedduu haleellaa gaggeessaa turteetti.

title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
english: Israel is shutting down all West Bank land crossings and banning Palestinian workers from entering Israeli settlements during the upcoming election on Tuesday. This decision follows a recent increase in military operations in the West Bank, including home demolitions, triggered by a deadly attack on Israeli soldiers. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claims these actions are part of a broader security crackdown, while critics view the intensified measures as politically motivated ahead of the vote.

oromo: Israa'el guyyaa filannoo Dilbata dhufuuf karoorfame kana, karaalee deemsaa gama Baankii Lixaa cufuufi hojjettoonni Falasxiin gara naannolee Israa'elitti akka hin galle dhorkiteetti. Murteen kun kan dhufey erga loltoonni Israa'el lama ajjeefamanii booda, naannicha keessatti duula waraanaa cimaan gaggeeffamaa jiruun wal qabatee dha. Ministirri Muummee Benyaamiin Neetanyaahuu tarkaanfichi nageenya kabachiisuuf kan taasifame yoo jedhanis, qaamoleen mirga namoomaa garuu tarkaanfichi filannicha dura dhiibbaa siyaasaa uumuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Voters in Brazil to choose between Lula and Bolsonaro's son
english: Brazil is holding a decisive presidential runoff election between the current leader, 80-year-old leftist Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and the right-wing senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Flávio is the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently imprisoned for attempting a coup after his previous election defeat. While Flávio led the initial round of voting with promises to cut spending and combat crime, Lula is campaigning to increase voter turnout to overcome his opponent's lead.
amharic: ብራዚል በነባሩ የግራ ዘመም መሪ ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና በቀኝ ዘመም ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ መካከል ወሳኝ የሆነ የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ እያካሄደች ነው። ፍላቪዮ ከዚህ ቀደም በተሸነፉበት ምርጫ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ለማድረግ በመሞከር እስር ቤት የሚገኙት የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ጃይር ቦልሶናሮ ልጅ ናቸው። ፍላቪዮ በምርጫው የመጀመሪያ ዙር ቀዳሚ በመሆን ወንጀልን ለመዋጋት እና የኢኮኖሚ ለውጥ ለማምጣት ቃል ሲገቡ፣ ሉላ ደግሞ ድጋፋቸውን በማጠናከር በሁለተኛው ዙር ለማሸነፍ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው።
oromo: Braziliin filannoo pireezidantummaa cimaa kan geggeessaa jirtu yoo ta'u, morkattoonni isaas hoogganaa amma aangoorra jiran Lula da Silva fi senatara mirga-gaafattuu Flávio Bolsonaro dha. Flávio ilma duraanii pireezidantii Jair Bolsonaro kan ta'an yoo ta'u, abbaan isaanii bu'aa filannoo duraanii fudhachuu diduun yaalii fonqolcha mootummaa taasisuun hidhaa jiru. title: Gunmen kill at least 10 villagers and loot shops in northeast Nigeria
english: Armed attackers on motorcycles raided Binnari village in northeastern Nigeria, killing at least 10 people and looting local shops. While police have confirmed 10 fatalities, local witnesses and organizations fear the death toll could reach as high as 50. Authorities are currently searching the surrounding area for further casualties as residents continue to voice concerns over the government's inability to stop frequent attacks on rural communities.
amharic: በሰሜን ምስራቅ ናይጄሪያ በቢናሪ መንደር የታጠቁ ሰዎች በሞተር ሳይክል በመምጣት ጥቃት ከፈቱ። ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ 10 ሰዎችን የገደሉ ሲሆን የሱቅ ንብረቶችን ዘርፈው ቤቶችን አቃጥለዋል። ምንም እንኳን ፖሊስ 10 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን ቢያረጋግጥም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና ሌሎች ምንጮች የሟቾች ቁጥር እስከ 50 ሊደርስ እንደሚችል በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Kaaba-Baha Naayijeeriyaatti namoonni hidhatan motor saayikiliin dhufanii baadiyaa Binnarii jedhamtutti haleellaa raawwataniin namoonni 10 ol ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaa kana keessatti shakkamttoonni kunneen suuqiiwwan saamuun manneen gubaniiru. Poolisiin reeffa 10 argachuu isaa mirkaneesseus, jiraattonni fi dhaabbileen biroo lakkoofsi namoota du'anii hanga 50 ga'uu akka danda'u shakkii qabu.

title: Nigeria’s missing: Families in the northeast still wait for answers
english: Many families in northeastern Nigeria are still struggling to find relatives who disappeared during years of conflict in the region. Organizations like the Association for the Well-being of Displaced and Missing Persons’ Families are supporting those left behind as they continue their long search for answers. Despite the passage of over a decade, these families remain hopeful while coping with the deep emotional pain caused by these unresolved losses.
amharic: በሰሜን ምስራቅ ናይጄሪያ በቆየው ግጭት ሳቢያ ለብዙ ዓመታት የጠፉባቸው ቤተሰቦች እስካሁን ድረስ የመረጃ እጦት እየተሰቃዩ ይገኛሉ። የጠፉ ሰዎች ቤተሰቦችን የሚረዳ ማህበር የተጎዱትን ሰዎች በመደገፍ ቤተሰቦቻቸውን እንዲፈልጉ ጥረት እያደረገ ነው። ከአስር ዓመታት በላይ ቢቆጠርም፣ ቤተሰቦቹ የጠፉባቸውን ወገኖቻቸውን የማግኘት ተስፋ ሳይቆርጡ ከፍተኛ የሃዘን ስሜት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo kaaba-bahaa Naayijeeriyaa keessatti, walitti buiinsa waggoota hedduu turteen namoonni hedduu erga badanii booda maatiin isaanii hanga ammaatti odeeffannoo dhabanii rakachaa jiru. Jaarmiyaaleen namoota badanii fi buqqa'aniif dhaabatan, maatii miidhaan kun irra ga'e gargaaruun barbaacha isaanii akka itti fufan jajjabeessaa jiru. Waggoota kudhan ol darbanii illee, maatiin kun abdii isaanii osoo hin kutatin, miidhaa fi gadda hamaa kana keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: Election posters, mass tourism and property: Israel’s footprint in Cyprus
english: Israel is exerting a growing influence in Cyprus through increased tourism, significant property investment, and even political campaigning on the island. While Cyprus has experienced foreign investment before, experts note that the current Israeli presence is unique because it is actively fostering permanent communities and shaping local political relations. Many Cypriots are concerned that this influx of capital and political activity is effectively pricing them out of their own country and changing its social fabric.
amharic: እስራኤል በቱሪዝም፣ በሪል እስቴት ኢንቨስትመንት እና በፖለቲካዊ ቅስቀሳዎች በቆጵሮስ ያላትን ተጽዕኖ እያሳደገች ነው። ቀደም ሲል ሌሎች አገራት በቆጵሮስ ኢንቨስት ያደርጉ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የአሁኑ የእስራኤል መገኘት ግን ዘላቂ ማህበረሰቦችን በመፍጠር እና የአካባቢውን ፖለቲካ በመቅረጽ የተለየ መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ብዙ የቆጵሮስ ዜጎች ይህ የኢኮኖሚ እና የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ የኑሮ ውድነትን እንደጨመረ እና አገራቸው እየተቀየረች እንደሆነ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el dameewwan turizimii, invastimantii qabeenyaa fi duula siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti adeemsifamuun Qiproos irratti dhiibbaa ishee guddisaa jirti. Kanaan dura biyyoonni biroon Qiproos keessatti invastimantii godhaa kan turan ta'us, dhiibbaan Israa'el ammaa kun hawaasoota dhaabbataa ijaaruu fi siyaasa biyyattii keessa galuun isaa isa adda godha. Lammiileen Qiproos hedduun dhiibbaan dinagdee fi siyaasaa kun gatii jireenyaa ol kaasuun akkasumas amalli biyyattii akka jijjiiramu godhaa jiraachuun isaa isaan yaaddessee jira.

title: Bots, deepfakes and surveillance: Israel’s election goes to war online
english: Israel's upcoming general election has become a digital battleground as Benjamin Netanyahu and his rivals engage in a heated online campaign. Both sides are utilizing AI-generated videos, deepfakes, and automated bot networks to sway voters and discredit their opponents. This heavy reliance on advanced technology is raising concerns about the fairness of the election and its impact on the nation's political landscape.
amharic: የእስራኤል መጪው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ እና በተቀናቃኞቻቸው መካከል በሚካሄድ ከፍተኛ የዲጂታል የቅስቀሳ ውጊያ ታጅቧል። ሁለቱም ወገኖች መራጮችን ለማሳመን እና ተቃዋሚዎቻቸውን ለማጠልሸት ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI)፣ የሐሰት ምስሎችን እና አውቶማቲክ የቦት ኔትወርኮችን እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ይህ በቴክኖሎጂ ላይ የተመሰረተ የቅስቀሳ ስልት የምርጫውን ፍትሃዊነት እና በአገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ የሚያሳድረውን ተጽዕኖ በተመለከተ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Filannoon biyyoolessa Israa'el dhufuuf jiru kun, murnoota wal dorgoman jidduutti lola dijitaalaa hamaa ta'e uumeera. Muummichi ministeeraa Beniyaamin Neetaanyaahuu fi mormitoonni isaa sagalee filattootaa argachuuf jecha teeknooloojii 'AI', viidiyoo sobaa fi 'bot' fayyadamuun wal arrabsachaa jiru. Fayyadama teeknooloojii kanaa fi hojiiwwan sobaa kun, haqa filannichaa irratti fi garaagarummaa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Serbia votes in election pitting longtime leader against student movement
english: Serbia is holding a critical parliamentary election that pits long-serving leader Aleksandar Vucic against a popular student-led movement. The protests, which seek to challenge corruption and authoritarianism, gained momentum following a tragic infrastructure collapse in 2024. While Vucic remains a powerful figure known for driving economic modernization, the student coalition represents the most significant political threat to his decade-long rule.
amharic: ሰርቢያ ለረጅም ጊዜ በስልጣን ላይ ባሉት አሌክሳንደር ቩቺች እና በተማሪዎች የሚመራ የተቃውሞ ንቅናቄ መካከል የሚደረግ ወሳኝ የፓርላማ ምርጫ እያካሄደች ነው። በ2024 በኖቪ ሳድ ከተማ በደረሰው አሳዛኝ የባቡር ጣቢያ አደጋ ምክንያት የተነሳው የተማሪዎች ንቅናቄ፣ በስልጣን ላይ ያለውን የመንግስት ሙስና እና አምባገነናዊ አሰራር በመቃወም ከፍተኛ ድጋፍ አግኝቷል። ምንም እንኳን ቩቺች የኢኮኖሚ እድገት አመጣሁ በማለት ተወዳጅነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ይህ የተማሪዎች ቡድን በአስር አመታት ውስጥ ትልቁን የፖለቲካ ፈተና ደቅኖባቸዋል።
oromo: Serbiyaan filannoo paarlaamaa kan hogganaa waggaa dheeraaf turan Aleksander Vuuchichii fi sochii barattootaa gidduutti gaggeeffamu tokko geggeessaa jirti. Sochiin barattootaa kun, balaa buufata baaburaa bara 2024 mudatee fi malaammaltummaa fi abbaa irrummaa balaaleffachuun kan jalqabame yoo ta'u, deggersa bal'aa argateera. Vuuchichin dinagdee biyyattii fooyyessaniiru jedhamaniis, gareen barattootaa kun waggoota kudhan darban keessatti mormii siyaasaa isa guddaa isaan mudate ta'ee jira.

title: Obama joins El-Sayed in Michigan rally cry before key midterms
english: Former President Barack Obama campaigned in Detroit to support Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed ahead of the midterm elections. During the rally, Obama spoke out against the prejudice some politicians face regarding their religious identity or background. His appearance emphasized the importance of inclusivity and supported a candidate in a city with a predominantly Black population.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ባራክ ኦባማ በመጪው የሴኔት ምርጫ ተወዳዳሪ ለሆኑት አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ ድጋፍ ለመስጠት በዲትሮይት ተገኝተዋል። በስብሰባው ላይ ኦባማ አንዳንድ እጩዎች በእምነታቸው ወይም በዘራቸው ምክንያት የሚደርስባቸውን የጥላቻ ንግግር በይፋ ተችተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት አብዛኛው ጥቁር አሜሪካውያን በሚኖሩበት ከተማ ውስጥ አካታችነትን ለማስፈን ያለመ ነበር።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Baaraak Obaamaan filannoo giddu-galeessaa duratti sagantaa deeggarsa kaadhimamaa Senetii Abduul El-Saayedif magaalaa Diitrootitti qophaa'e irratti argamaniiru. Obaamaan haasaa taasisaniin, kaadhimamtoonni amantii ykn gosa isaaniin walqabatee jibbiinsaan akka qeeqaman mormaniiru. Deeggarsi kun ummata gurraacha baay'ina qabu biratti tokkummaa fi walqixxummaa jajjabeessuuf kan gumaache ture.

title: Raw Meat, Rising Costs, Emptier Tables
english: The price of raw meat in Addis Abeba has surged significantly, rising from under 1,000 Birr to 1,600 Birr per kilogram over the last two years. While consumers have started a social media boycott, vendors point to rising expenses like transportation, cattle prices, and rent as the primary drivers of this inflation. Experts argue that government interventions or consumer boycotts will be ineffective unless the underlying supply chain costs and trade route security issues are addressed.
amharic: በአዲስ አበባ የጥሬ ሥጋ ዋጋ ባለፉት ሁለት ዓመታት ከነበረበት ከ1,000 ብር በታች ወደ 1,600 ብር ከፍ ብሏል። ሸማቾች በበኩላቸው በምርቱ ውድነት ተቃውሟቸውን ለማሰማት በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ ዘመቻ ቢጀምሩም፣ ነጋዴዎች የዋጋ ጭማሪው የመጣው በከብት መኖ፣ በትራንስፖርት እና በኪራይ ዋጋ ንረት ምክንያት መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ። ኢኮኖሚስቶች እንደሚሉት፣ የንግድ መስመሮችን ደህንነት እና የአቅርቦት ሰንሰለት ወጪዎችን ሳይቀንስ መንግስት የሚወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች ወይም የሸማቾች ተቃውሞ ዘላቂ መፍትሄ አያመጡም።
oromo: Gatiin foon duudaa magaalaa Finfinnee keessatti waggoota lamaan darban keessa birrii 1,000 gadirraa gara birrii 1,600tti ol guddateera. Gatii kana mormuudhaaf uummanni miidiyaa hawaasummaa fayyadamee shororkaa yoo godhu, daldaltoonni garuu gatiin kun kan dabale gatii loonii, geejjibaafi kiree manaafi kan biroo dabaluusaatiin akka ta'e dubbatu. Hayyoonni diinagdee akka jedhanitti, rakkoolee geejjibaafi gatii gabaa keessaa furuu malee, tarkaanfiin mootummaan fudhatu ykn mormiin ummanni godhu jijjiirama bu'a qabeessa hin fidu.

title: MIDROC Breaks Ground on a Second Sheraton-branded Hotel
english: MIDROC Ethiopia has begun construction on a second Sheraton-branded hotel within the existing Sheraton Addis compound. The project, which is estimated to cost around 116 million dollars, is receiving 80 million dollars in financing from the International Finance Corporation to assist with long-term foreign currency requirements. Several local firms, including DEZACON Construction and ZIAS Architecture, have been hired to manage the design and build process.
amharic: ሚድሮክ ኢትዮጵያ በአዲስ አበባ ሸራተን ግቢ ውስጥ ሁለተኛ የሸራተን ሆቴል ግንባታ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ወደ 116 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት ወጪ የሚጠይቀው ይህ ፕሮጀክት፣ ከዓለም ባንክ ቡድን ቅርንጫፍ የሆነው ዓለም አቀፍ የፋይናንስ ኮርፖሬሽን (IFC) እስከ 80 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚደርስ የረጅም ጊዜ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ብድር ድጋፍ ያደርግለታል። የሆቴሉን ዲዛይንና ግንባታ ለማከናወን እንደ ዲዛኮን ኮንስትራክሽን እና ዚያስ አርክቴክቸር ያሉ የአገር ውስጥ ድርጅቶች ተቀጥረው እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Miidirookiin Itoophiyaa gamoowwan Sheraton Addis keessatti hoteela Sheraton lammaffaa ta’e tokko ijaaruu jalqabeera. Hojiin ijaarsaa kun qarshii miliyoona 116 ga’u kan itti ba’u yoo ta’u, dhaabbanni IFC (International Finance Corporation) deeggarsa qarshii miliyoona 80 ta’u guutuuf qophiidha. Deeggarsi kunis faayidaa jijjiirraa maallaqa alaa yeroo dheeraa kennuuf kan gargaaruudha; hojii kanaafis dhaabbileen ijaarsaa fi diizaayinii biyya keessaa adda addaa xiyyeeffannoo fudhataniiru.

title: Mastercard Taps the Domestic Market Where Only One Adult in Five Transacts Digitally
english: Mastercard is applying for official permission to expand its services into the local Ethiopian payments market. The company aims to move beyond international transactions to help increase digital financial access in a region where few adults use digital methods. Their success will largely depend on meeting upcoming government regulations regarding data security and financial standards.
amharic: ማስተርካርድ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ የውስጥ የክፍያ ገበያ ለመግባት ፈቃድ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል። ኩባንያው ከአለም አቀፍ የክፍያ አገልግሎት ባለፈ በሀገር ውስጥ የዲጂታል የፋይናንስ ተደራሽነትን ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው። ስኬታቸውም በመንግስት በሚወጡ የውሂብ ደህንነት እና የፋይናንስ ደንቦች ላይ የተመሰረተ ይሆናል።
oromo: Maasterkaard gabaa kaffaltii keessa biyyaa Itoophiyaa keessatti tajaajila isaa babal'isuuf hayyama gaafachaa jira. Dhaabbatichi hojii kaffaltii idil-addunyaa darbee, biyyattii keessatti fayyadamummaa tajaajila faayinaansii dijitaalaa dabaluuf karoorfateera. Milkaa'inni isaanii seerota mootummaan nageenya odeeffannoo fi sirna faayinaansii irratti baasu irratti kan hundaa'e ta'a.

title: Capital Authority, Securities Exchange Spar Over Who Decides Shareholder Rights
english: A dispute has emerged between the Capital Market Authority and the Securities Exchange regarding which entity holds the authority to set cut-off dates for shareholder dividends and voting rights. The Exchange is calling for the regulator to establish clear deadlines to avoid confusion during upcoming annual general meetings for banks. However, the Authority maintains that current regulations already clearly define who is responsible for these determinations.
amharic: የካፒታል ገበያ ባለስልጣን እና የዋስትናዎች ልውውጥ ተቋም የባለአክሲዮኖች የትርፍ ድርሻ ክፍያ እና የምርጫ መብት ቀነ-ገደብ ማን መወሰን እንዳለበት አለመግባባት ውስጥ ገብተዋል። የዋስትናዎች ልውውጥ ተቋሙ በባንኮች አመታዊ ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ግልጽነት እንዲኖር ባለስልጣኑ የጊዜ ገደብ እንዲያስቀምጥ ይጠይቃል። ባለስልጣኑ በበኩሉ አሁን ባለው ደንብ መሰረት ይህ ስልጣን በግልፅ መወሰኑን ይከራከራል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa gabaa kaappitaalaa fi gabaan aksiyoonaa mirga abbootii qabeenyaa fi kaffaltii qooda faayidaa irratti guyyaa murteessuu qabu eenyu irratti wal dhabuun isaanii beekameera. Gabaan aksiyoonaa qaamni to'atu akka guyyaa murteessuuf gaafatus, abbaan taayitaa garuu seerrini amma jiru eenyu akka itti gaafatamamu ifatti kaa'eera jedha. Wal dhabdee kanaan kan ka'e, yaa'ii idilee baankotaa irratti rakkoon akka hin uumamneef furmaatni barbaadamaa jira.

title: Farm Insurance Retreats as El Niño Advances
english: A food security monitoring group reports that poor rainfall has caused significant harvest losses across parts of Tigray, Amhara, and Afar in 2026. While southern regions face the threat of impending floods, smallholder farmers are finding it increasingly difficult to secure insurance against these climate-related risks. Experts note that while insurance is a helpful tool, it remains limited in its ability to protect farmers from the severe impacts of El Niño.
amharic: የምግብ ዋስትናን የሚከታተል ቡድን እንደዘገበው በ2026 የዝናብ እጥረት በታይግራይ፣ በአማራ እና በአፋር ክልሎች በሰብል ምርት ላይ ከፍተኛ ኪሳራ አስከትሏል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በደቡባዊ የኢትዮጵያ ክፍሎች የጎርፍ አደጋ ስጋት የተጋረጠ ሲሆን፣ አርሶ አደሮች የአየር ንብረት ተጽዕኖዎችን ለመከላከል የሚያስችል የኢንሹራንስ ሽፋን ማግኘት እየተቸገሩ ነው። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ኢንሹራንስ ለገበሬዎች መፍትሄ ቢሆንም፣ በኤል ኒኖ ምክንያት የሚመጣን ከባድ የአየር ንብረት ጉዳት ሙሉ በሙሉ ለመሸፈን ውስንነት አለው።
oromo: Garee nageenya nyaataa hordofu akka gabaasetti, roobni gahaa ta'e dhabamuun bara 2026 naannolee Tigraay, Amaaraa fi Afaaritti midhaan qonnaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Itoophiyaa kibbaatti immoo sodaan lolaa mudachuu danda'u waan jiruuf, qonnaan bultoonni miidhaa jijjiirama qilleensaa kanaan walqabatuuf inshuraansii argachuun isaanitti ulfaataa dhufeera. Ogeeyyiin akka ibsanitti, inshuraansin gargaarsa yoo ta'e iyyuu, miidhaa cimaa El Niinoon gahu hunda guutummaatti ittisuuf daangaa qaba.

title: Obama slams Trump’s ‘cruelty and corruption’ at Ohio rally for Democrats
english: Former President Barack Obama recently criticized Donald Trump at an Ohio campaign rally, accusing his administration of incompetence, corruption, and starting an unnecessary war with Iran. Obama urged voters to reject Republican leadership during the upcoming midterm elections, citing the current chaos as a reason for change. Additionally, he defended Democratic candidate Amy Acton against a controversial and personal attack advertisement supported by her Republican opponent.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ባራክ ኦባማ በኦሃዮ በተደረገ የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ላይ ዶናልድ ትራምፕን በብቃት ማነስ፣ በሙስና እና ኢራን ላይ አላስፈላጊ ጦርነት በመክፈታቸው ክፉኛ ተቸዋል። ኦባማ መጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ አሁን ካለው የፖለቲካ ምስቅልቅል ለመውጣት እድል ስለሆነ መራጮች ለሪፐብሊካን አስተዳደር ድምጽ እንዳይሰጡ አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በዴሞክራቲክ እጩ በአሚ አክተን ላይ በሪፐብሊካን ተፎካካሪዋ በኩል ስለቀረበው አወዛጋቢ የማጥቂያ ማስታወቂያ በመቃወም እጩዋን ደግፈዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii duraanii Baaraak Obaamaa godina Ohaayoo keessatti yaada wixinee filannoo irratti Donald Tiraampii irratti komii cimaa dhiyeessanii, bulchiinsa isaanii yakka, malaammaltummaa fi waraana Iiraan waliin godhamaa jiru kan barbaachisu miti jechuun ceephooraan. Obaamaan filattoonni filannoo giddu-galeessa bara kanaa irratti mootummaa riippuublikaanotaa akka hin deggarre gaafachuu isaanii fi yeroo ammaa biyyattiin rakkoo cimaa keessa akka jirtu ibsanii jiru. Kana malees, kaadhimamtuu paarlaamaa kan taate Amy Acton irratti gostiifi beekamtii siyaasaa ishee xureessuuf gahiinsa yaadannoowwan dogoggoraa fi qaaniin guutame tokko mormuun, ishee akka deggaran waamicha dhiyeessaniiru.

title: Violence breaks out across Europe after another day of protests
english: Demonstrations across several European nations have escalated into violent confrontations between citizens and law enforcement. Protesters are expressing their frustration over increasing living expenses, reductions in public services, and government military expenditures. Authorities in countries like France, Italy, and Spain have responded to the civil unrest and property damage by using tear gas and batons to disperse the crowds.
amharic: በአውሮፓ በተለያዩ ሀገራት የተነሱ ተቃውሞዎች በህዝብ እና በፖሊስ መካከል ወደ ግጭት ተቀይረዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ እየጨመረ የመጣውን የኑሮ ውድነት፣ የመንግስት አገልግሎቶች መቆራረጥ እና ለወታደራዊ ጉዳዮች የሚውለውን ከፍተኛ ወጪ በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው። በፈረንሳይ፣ በጣሊያን እና በስፔን የሚገኙ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች አመጹን ለመቆጣጠር አስለቃሽ ጭስ እና ሌሎች የኃይል እርምጃዎችን በመጠቀም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Biyyoota Awurooppaa garaa garaa keessatti hiriirri mormii bal’inaan gaggeeffamaa jiru gara walitti bu’iinsa humnoota nageenyaa wajjin godhamutti jijjiirameera. Hiriirtotni gatii jireenyaa olka’uu, tajaajiloota ummataa hir’achuu fi baasii waraanaatiin mufachuu isaanii ibsatan. Biyyoota akka Faransaay, Xaaliyaanii fi Ispeen keessatti poolisiin mormitoota bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaansuu fi meeshaalee waraanaatti fayyadamee jira.

title: Iran war live: Trump hints at possible Sunday Iran attack or deal reached
english: President Donald Trump has indicated that the United States is weighing its options regarding Iran, suggesting a potential military strike could occur as early as Sunday or that a diplomatic agreement might still be possible. Meanwhile, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has criticized the U.S. for the failure of recent interim negotiations while still expressing a willingness to pursue a resolution. The situation remains uncertain as both nations navigate between the possibilities of conflict and a peaceful deal.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ እያሰበች እንደሆነ ወይም አዲስ ስምምነት ላይ ሊደረስ እንደሚችል ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል። የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት መስዑድ 페ዘሽኪያን በበኩላቸው የአሜሪካ መንግሥት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች መስተጓጎል ላይ ተጠያቂ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ቢተቹም፣ አሁንም በስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እንደሚፈልጉ ገልጸዋል። የአሁኑ ሁኔታ በጦርነት እና በሰላማዊ ድርድር መካከል ያለው አሻሚነት ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan Iiraan irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuuf akka jirtu ykn mariin isaanii gara waliigaltee guddaa tokkotti akka geessu yaada qabu. Gama biraatiin, Pireezidaantiin Iiraan Mas'uud Pezeeshkiyaan mariin diippiloomaasii akka hin milkoofneef Ameerikaa kan komatan yoo ta'u, waliigaltee tokko irratti gahuuf fedhii akka qaban ibsaniiru. Haalli kun hanga ammaa waraanaa fi nagaa gidduutti kan raafamu ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: Obama blames Trump for 'starting unnecessary war nobody asked for'
english: Former President Barack Obama has sharply criticized Donald Trump for withdrawing from the 2015 Iran nuclear deal, arguing that the decision sparked an avoidable conflict. Obama claimed that his own diplomatic approach successfully contained Iran's nuclear program without military force, whereas current tensions have disrupted oil markets and increased consumer prices. During a campaign event in Ohio, he urged voters to support change, labeling Trump's administration as defined by instability and poor decision-making.
amharic: ቀድሞ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ፕሬዝዳንት ባራክ ኦባማ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከ2015ቱ የኢራን የኒውክሌር ስምምነት መውጣታቸውን በመተቸት ይህ ውሳኔ አላስፈላጊ ግጭት እንደፈጠረ ገልጸዋል። ኦባማ በንግግራቸው ወቅት፣ የራሳቸው የዲፕሎማሲ መንገድ የኢራንን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም በወታደራዊ ኃይል ሳይሆን በተሳካ ሁኔታ መቆጣጠር እንደቻለ አስታውሰዋል። አሁን ያለው ውጥረት የነዳጅ ገበያውን በማወኩ የሸቀጦች ዋጋ እንዲንር እንዳደረገው በመግለጽ፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በብቃት ማነስ እና በችግር የተሞላ መሆኑን በመተቸት መራጮች ለውጥ እንዲፈልጉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Baaraak Obaamaa, Doonaald Tiraamp waliigaltee niwukilaraa Iraan kan bara 2015 irraa ba'uu isaanii cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Obaamaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun lola hin barbaachifne kan uume yoo ta'u, gama isaaniin mala dippiloomaasiitti fayyadamuun osoo lola hin banin fedhii niwukilaraa Iraan to'achuu danda'anii turan. Gurgurtaa boba'aa irratti dhiibbaa uumameefi gatiin meeshaalee gabaa irratti dabaluun isaa, siyaasa Tiraamp kan of eeggannoo hin qabne ta'uu ibsanii, filattoonni Ohaayoo jijjiiramni akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru.

title: Israel restricts entry of Palestinian labourers to West Bank areas
english: The Israeli military has announced new travel restrictions for Palestinian workers in the occupied West Bank. Palestinians with work permits will be prohibited from entering most settlement areas this Sunday and Monday. Additionally, all land crossings will be closed and movement will be completely suspended during the upcoming election day on October 27, 2026.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ለሚሰሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ሰራተኞች አዲስ የጉዞ ገደብ ጥሏል። በዚህ መሰረት፣ የስራ ፈቃድ ያላቸው ፍልስጤማውያን እሁድ እና ሰኞ በአብዛኛዎቹ ሰፈራዎች እንዳይገቡ ተከልክለዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በጥቅምት 27 ቀን 2026 በሚካሄደው የምርጫ ቀን፣ ሁሉም የምድር ድንበር መተላለፊያዎች ተዘግተው እንቅስቃሴ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቋረጥ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el hojjettoota Falasxiin kan naannoo Daandii Lixaa (West Bank) keessa jiraniif dambii daangaa imala haaraa baaseera. Hojjettoonni hayyama hojii qaban Dilbata fi Wixata dhuftu bakkeewwan qubata hedduu keessatti akka hin galle dhorkamaniiru. Kana malees, guyyaa filannoo Sadaasa 27, 2026, qaxxaamura lafoo hunda cufuun sochii guutummaatti dhaabuuf murteeffameera.

title: Thousands rally in Tel Aviv against Netanyahu ahead of elections
english: Thousands of protesters marched in Tel Aviv to demand accountability from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s government just days before a critical election. The demonstration was organized by families of victims and hostages affected by the October 7 Hamas attack, who are calling for an official inquiry into the security failures. Prominent opposition leaders joined the crowd to express their disapproval of the current administration's leadership during the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ሊካሄድ ሶስት ቀናት ሲቀሩት በቴል አቪቭ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ላይ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። ሰልፉ የተዘጋጀው ጥቅምት 7 ቀን በተፈጸመው ጥቃት ለተጎዱ ቤተሰቦች እና ታጋቾች ወገንተኞች ሲሆን፣ መንግስት የጸጥታ ችግሮችን ለመከላከል ባለመቻሉ ተጠያቂ እንዲሆን ጠይቀዋል። የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎችም በተቃውሞው በመሳተፍ አሁን ያለው የመንግስት አመራር ብቃት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Guyyoota muraasa dura filannoo biyyoolessaatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman magaalaa Tel Aviv keessatti mormii mootummaa muummicha ministeeraa Beniyaamiin Netiyaahuyirratti geggeessaniiru. Hiriirri kun kan qophaa'e maatii namoota muddee 7 haleellaa Hamasiin miidhamanii fi butamanii fi mootummaan haleellaa kana ittisuu dhabuusaatiif itti gaafatamummaa akka fudhatu gaafachuufi. Hoggantoonni paartilee mormituu ijoo ta'anis hiriira kana irratti hirmaachuun, mootummaan amma jiru rakkoo biyyattii furuuf dandeettii akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: Six Palestinian children treated for tear gas suffocation in Hebron
english: In the West Bank city of Hebron, Israeli forces have closed off the area and displaced thousands of residents following a fatal shooting attack on soldiers at a checkpoint. During these security operations, six children were among a group of Palestinians who required medical attention due to tear gas inhalation. The military restrictions and evacuations were implemented after two Israeli soldiers were killed in a confrontation on Friday.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ሄብሮን ከተማ በወታደሮች ላይ በተፈጸመ ገዳይ ጥቃት ምክንያት የእስራኤል ኃይሎች አካባቢውን ዘግተው በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎችን አፈናቅለዋል። በዚህ ግጭት ወቅት ስድስት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ዘጠኝ ፍልስጤማውያን በእንባ ጋዝ በመታፈናቸው የህክምና እርዳታ አግኝተዋል። ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እና የመኖሪያ ቤት መፈናቀል የተፈጸመው አርብ ዕለት ሁለት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተገደሉበት ጥቃት ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Magalaa Hebroon kan Qarqara Lixaatti argamtu keessatti, haleellaa loltoota irratti raawwatameen booda, humnoonni Israa'el naannichatti daangaa gadi baasuun jiraattoota kumaan lakkaawaman buqqisaniiru. Hojiilee nageenya kabachiisuu kana keessatti, daa'imman jahan dabalatee namoonni sagal qilleensa imimmaanuu (tear gas) sanaan miidhamuun wal'aansa argataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga guyyaa Jimaataa loltoonni Israa'el lama haleellaa kanaan ajjeefamanii booda.

title: Drone destroyed in Riyadh region as explosions rock southern Yemen
english: Saudi-led coalition forces successfully neutralized a drone targeting the Riyadh region, while reports of intense explosions emerged from southern Yemen. Regional leaders have strongly condemned these Houthi-linked attacks, specifically highlighting the danger posed to holy sites in Mecca by falling ballistic missile debris. Officials described the ongoing violence as a serious threat to regional stability and a reckless disregard for civilian safety.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሪያድ አካባቢ የተተኮሰ ድሮን ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል፤ በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በደቡብ የመን አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። የባህረ ሰላጤው የትብብር ምክር ቤት እነዚህን ጥቃቶች ያወገዘ ሲሆን በተለይም በሜካ የተቀደሱ ስፍራዎች ላይ የደረሰውን የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤል ቅሪት አደጋ አውግዟል። ይህ ድርጊት የክልሉን ሰላም የሚያውክ እና የንፁሃን ዜጎችን ህይወት ለአደጋ የጣለ ነው ተብሏል።
oromo: Humnoonni gamtaa Saudii qajeelfamu, xiyyara nama hin feene kan gara Riyaaditti bobbaafame caccabsuu isaanii beeksisaniiru, akkasumas lafa Yaman kibbatti dhoochaan cimaan dhagahameera. Hoggantoonni naannichaa haleellaa garee Huutii kana jabinaan kan balaaleffatan yoo ta'u, keessattuu meeshaan waraanaa gara Makkaatti kufuun bakkeewwan qulqulluu irratti soda uumuu isaa ibsaniiru. Gochi kun tasgabbii naannichaa kan booreessuufi jireenya nagaa irratti miidhaa hamaa kan qabu ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Trump lauds Melania over Russia-Ukraine localised ceasefire deal
english: Donald Trump recently commended First Lady Melania Trump for her involvement in securing a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Oleshky region. While voting in the midterm elections, the president claimed her diplomatic contribution was more effective than that of official government experts. This praise highlights Melania Trump’s unexpected role in high-level international mediation efforts.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ቀዳማዊት እመቤት ሜላኒያ ትራምፕ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል በኦሌሽኪ ክልል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት እንዲደረግ ላደረጉት ጥረት አመስግነዋል። የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ ድምፅ ሲሰጡ እንደተናገሩት፣ የሜላኒያ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት ከመንግስት ባለሙያዎች የተሻለ ውጤት አስገኝቷል። ይህም የሜላኒያ ትራምፕን ያልተጠበቀ የአለም አቀፍ የሰላም አስከባሪ ሚና ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Trump haadha manaa isaanii Melania Trump, naannoo Oleshky keessatti gidduu biyyoota Russia fi Ukraine marii araaraa taasiisuuf carraaqqii isaan godhaniif galateeffatan. Pirezidaantichi filannoo gidduu waggaarratti sagalee kennuuf yeroo turanitti, ogummaan diippilomaasii isaan agarsiisan kan ogeeyyota mootummaa caaluu ibsan. Gadi-fageenyi kun gahee Melania Trump karaa tasaa marii araaraa idil-addunyaa keessatti qabaachuu danda'an mul'isa.

title: Gunmen kill at least 10 people in eastern Nigeria, police say
english: A large group of armed men on motorcycles attacked Binnari village in Nigeria's Taraba State, resulting in a significant loss of life. While police initially confirmed 10 deaths, local residents and rights groups suggest the toll may be much higher, potentially reaching 40 people. During the raid, the attackers also looted food, cash, and supplies, highlighting the ongoing security challenges posed by violent gangs in rural Nigeria.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ታራባ ግዛት በቢናሪ መንደር የታጠቁ ሰዎች በሞተር ሳይክል በመምጣት በፈጸሙት ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ፖሊስ ቢያንስ 10 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ያረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች የሟቾች ቁጥር እስከ 40 ሊደርስ እንደሚችል ገልጸዋል። አጥቂዎቹ ሰዎችን ከመግደላቸው በተጨማሪ የገበያ መደብሮችን በመዝረፍ ምግብ እና ገንዘብ ዘርፈው መሄዳቸው፣ በገጠር አካባቢዎች የሚስተዋለውን የጸጥታ ችግር አባብሶታል።
oromo: Naayijeeriya keessatti gareen hidhatee jiru tokko baandiiwwan mootar-sayikiliin dhufanii baadiyaa biyya Taraba, ganda Biinaarii keessatti haleellaa raawwataniin namoonni hedduun ajjeefaman. Poolisiin lubbuun namoota 10 darbuusaa mirkaneessus, jiraattonniifi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa lakkoofsi namoota du'anii hanga 40 gahuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru. Haleellaa kana booda, gareen kun suuqiiwwan saamuudhaan nyaataafi qarshii fudhatanii kan bahan yommuu ta'u, kunis rakkoo nageenyaa baadiyaa Naayijeeriya keessatti mudataa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: How have Democrats’ policies shifted since the last major US election?
english: Following their 2024 election defeat, Democratic candidates are adjusting their policy positions to better align with changing voter priorities ahead of the 2026 midterms. The party is experiencing internal friction as moderates face pressure from a growing progressive movement demanding bolder stances on critical topics. Notably, there is a clear shift toward stronger criticism of Israel's military actions in Gaza, reflecting broader changes in public opinion.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 በተካሄደው ምርጫ ከተሸነፉ በኋላ፣ የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩዎች ለ2026 የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ዝግጅት እንደ መራጮች ፍላጎት አዳዲስ ፖሊሲዎችን እየቀረጹ ነው። ፓርቲው በመጠነኛ አቋም ያላቸው አባላት እና ይበልጥ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችን በሚጠይቁ ተራማጅ አባላት መካከል ባለው ልዩነት እየተፈተነ ይገኛል። በተለይም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በመቃወም ረገድ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ እየታየ ሲሆን ይህም የህዝብ አስተያየት መቀየሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoo bara 2024 erga injifatamanii booda, kaadhimamtoonni paartii Dimokiraatawaa filannoo giddu-galeessa bara 2026 dura fedhii fi yaada ummataa irratti hundaa'uun imaammata isaanii haaromsaa jiru. Paartiin kun giduu isaanii, warra giddu-galeessa ta'anii fi warra jijjiirama cimaa barbaadan gidduutti wal dhabdee keessoo mudachaa jira. Keessattuu, tarkaanfii waraana Israa'el kan Gaaza keessatti raawwatamu mormuun bal'inaan dabaluun isaa, jijjiirama yaada ummataa US keessatti mul'achaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Brazil’s Lula, Bolsonaro draw thousands to election-eve rallies
english: Brazil's presidential candidates, Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro, held massive final rallies as they prepare for a highly competitive run-off election. The race is extremely close, with recent polling showing both candidates in a virtual tie as voters decide between the incumbent's left-wing policies and a shift toward the right. Supporters of each side gathered across the country to express their opposing visions for Brazil's economic and political future.
amharic: የብራዚል የፕሬዚዳንት እጩዎች ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ፣ ለሚካሄደው ወሳኝ የምርጫ ፍፃሜ የመጨረሻ የድጋፍ ሰልፎቻቸውን በስፋት አድርገዋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ የሕዝብ አስተያየቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ሁለቱ እጩዎች እኩል በሆነ ደረጃ ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ መራጮች በነባሩ የግራ ዘንበል ፖሊሲ እና በአዲሱ የቀኝ ዘንበል አቅጣጫ መካከል ምርጫ ለማድረግ ተዘጋጅተዋል። የየእጩዎቹ ደጋፊዎችም ለሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚና የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ያላቸውን የተለያየ አመለካከት በመግለጽ በአደባባይ ወጥተዋል።
oromo: Hirmaattotni filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyya Braazil, Lu'iiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa fi Flaaviyoo Bolsonaaroon, guyyaa filannoo dura goolaba duula filannoo isaanii bal'aa ta'e gaggeeffataniiru. Filannoon kun baay'ee kan wal morkachiise ta'ee, qorannoon uummataa akka agarsiisutti kaadhimamtoonni lamaanuu wal qixa akka jiranidha. Lammiileen Braazil siyaasa bitaa kan ammaa fi jijjiirama gara mirgaatti godhamu gidduutti filannoo cimaa godhuuf qophaa'aniiru; deggertoonnis jijjiirama siyaasaa fi dinagdee biyyattii irratti yaada adda addaa qaban ibsachuuf walgahaniiru.

title: Brazil’s candidates hold final rallies before knife-edge run off
english: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and his opponent have held their final campaign rallies ahead of Brazil’s highly anticipated runoff election this Sunday. Recent polling data shows the two candidates in a dead heat, with both sides tied at 50% support. The nation remains deeply divided as voters prepare to head to the polls to decide the presidency.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና ተፎካካሪያቸው እሁድ በሚካሄደው የብራዚል ወሳኝ የምርጫ ዙር ዋዜማ የመጨረሻ የምርጫ ቅስቀሳቸውን አድርገዋል። የቅርብ ጊዜ የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ሁለቱም እጩዎች እኩል በሆነ የ50 በመቶ ድጋፍ ላይ ይገኛሉ። አገሪቱ በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ባለችበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ መራጮች ለቀጣይ ፕሬዝዳንት ድምፃቸውን ለመስጠት እየተዘጋጁ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luula da Siilvaa fi morkataan isaanii Dilbata dhufu kan gaggeeffamu filannoo biyyattii isa xumuraa dura yaada ummataa isaanii dhumaa ibsataniiru. Qorannoon sagalee ummataa akka agarsiisutti, kaadhimamtoonni lamaanuu walqixa harka 50 ta'uun wal-qixxee dha. Biyyattiin murtee cimaa irra waan jirtuuf, lammiileen itti aanaa biyyattii filachuuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
english: Hundreds of thousands of people across France participated in widespread protests regarding living costs and school conditions, leading to nearly 1,000 arrests. While most demonstrations remained peaceful, clashes broke out in cities like Paris and Marseille, prompting police to use tear gas and water cannons. Authorities deployed 70,000 officers to maintain order and prevent the severe destruction seen during previous weeks of unrest.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የኑሮ ውድነትን እና የትምህርት ቤት ሁኔታዎችን በመቃወም በመላ ሀገሪቱ በተካሄደው ሰፊ ሰልፍ ወደ አንድ ሺህ የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ታሰሩ። ሰልፎቹ በአብዛኛው ሰላማዊ ቢሆኑም በፓሪስ እና በማርሴ ከተሞች በተቀሰቀሱ ግጭቶች ፖሊስ አስለቃሽ ጭስ እና የውሃ መድፍ ተጠቅሟል። ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል ታይቶ የነበረውን ከፍተኛ ሁከት ለመከላከል 70 ሺህ የፖሊስ አባላትን በየከተሞቹ አሰማርተዋል።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti mormii gatii jireenyaa fi haala mana barnootaa ilaalchisee guyyaa guutuu biyyattii hiriira guddaan erga gaggeeffamee booda, namoonni kuma tokkoo gadi ta'an to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Hiriironni hedduun nagaadhaan kan xumuraman ta'us, magaalonni akka Paariisii fi Maarseel keessatti walitti buiinsi uumamee poolisiin gaazii imimmaaniin fi bishaan dhiibbaa qabuun fayyadameera. Mootummaan miidhaa fi badii kanaan dura mul'ate hir'isuuf jecha poolisoota kuma 70 irratti bobbaasuun nageenya eegsisuuf yaaleera.

title: Severe hunger stalks people in Gaza as bakeries close down
english: Gaza is facing an acute food crisis as bakeries are forced to shut down due to a severe shortage of flour. Families are struggling to find bread, while humanitarian organizations are hampered by insufficient funding to deliver essential aid. Experts have issued urgent warnings that the region is on the brink of widespread famine.
amharic: ጋዛ ውስጥ የዱቄት እጥረት በመኖሩ ምክንያት የዳቦ መጋገሪያዎች መዘጋታቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ የምግብ ቀውስ ተፈጥሯል። ቤተሰቦች ዳቦ ለማግኘት እየተቸገሩ ሲሆን፣ የሰብአዊ ድርጅቶችም የገንዘብ እጥረት ስላለባቸው አስፈላጊውን እርዳታ ማቅረብ አልቻሉም። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች አካባቢው ለረሃብ አደጋ መጋለጡን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gaazaatti dhibee daakuu irraa kan ka'e bakkeewwan daabboo dubbisan cufamaa jiru, kunis rakkoo beelaa cimaa uumee jira. Maatiin daabboo argachuuf baay'ee rakkachaa jiru, akkasumas dhaabbileen gargaarsa namoomaa qarshiin waan hin jirreef gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e gahuu hin dandeenye. Hayyoonni mirga namoomaa naannichi beela hamaaf saaxilamuu isaa akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Violent clashes as Albanian government cracks down on protests
english: Anti-government demonstrations in Albania have escalated into violent confrontations between citizens and law enforcement for the twelfth consecutive day. Authorities in Tirana deployed water cannons, tear gas, and rubber bullets to disperse the crowds. This crackdown follows a direct warning from Prime Minister Edi Rama that he would take decisive measures to end the ongoing protests.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ለተከታታይ አስራ ሁለት ቀናት ሲካሄዱ በቆዩት ፀረ-መንግስት ሰልፎች ወቅት በህዝብ እና በፖሊስ መካከል ከፍተኛ ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። የሀገሪቱ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና ውስጥ ፖሊስ ተቃዋሚዎችን ለመበተን የውሃ መድፍ፣ አስለቃሽ ጭስ እና የጎማ ጥይቶችን ተጠቅሟል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ተቃውሞውን ለማስቆም ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ካስጠነቀቁ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Albaaniyaatti hiriirri mormii mootummaa irratti gaggeeffamaa ture guyyaa kudha lameessaaf walitti buiinsa hamaa gara hiriirtotaafi poolisii gidduutti taasifamee keessa seeneera. Magaalaa guddoo Tiraanaa keessatti poolisiin hiriirtota bittinneessuuf bishaan afuufuu, gaazii imimmaansuu fi rasaasa raabaraa itti fayyadameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga Muummichi Ministiraa Edi Raamaa mormii kana dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu akka malu akeekkachiisanii boodadha.

title: Could Israel’s military crackdown influence Tuesday’s election?
english: Following the deaths of two Israeli soldiers near Hebron, Israel has initiated a significant military operation and lockdown throughout the occupied West Bank. Palestinians have criticized these measures as a form of collective punishment that includes forced evictions and home demolitions. With national elections approaching, right-wing politicians are using the situation to advocate for more aggressive policies and territorial annexation, sparking debates about whether the crackdown is truly for security or political gain.
amharic: በሄብሮን አቅራቢያ ሁለት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ እስራኤል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ሁሉን አቀፍ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻና የሰዓት እላፊ ገድብ ጥላለች። ፍልስጤማውያን ይህ እርምጃ ቤቶችን ማፍረስና ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው ማፈናቀልን የያዘ የጋራ ቅጣት እንደሆነ ይከሳሉ። በሌላ በኩል፣ ምርጫው መቃረቡን ተከትሎ የቀኝ ዘመም ፖለቲከኞች ሁኔታውን በመጠቀም ይበልጥ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችንና መሬቶችን የመቀላቀል እቅዳቸውን ለማራመድ እየተጠቀሙበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el loltoota isaanii lama naannoo Hebroonitti erga ajjeefamanii booda, lafa daangeffamee jiru (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii cimaa fi uggura waraana bal'aa fudhateera. Ummanni Falasxiin tarkaanfii kanaan mana diiguu fi uummata qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqisuun wal-qabatee adaba waliinii akka ta'e dubbatu. Yeroo filannoon biyyoolessaa dhihaatetti, siyaasolleen garee mirgaa (far-right) haala kana fayyadamuun tarkaanfii hamaa fudhachuu fi lafa Falasxiin qabachuu akka barbaadan ibsataa jiru.

title: Arsenal join Man City at Premier League summit, Spurs shock Chelsea 2-0
english: Arsenal has moved level on points with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League after a 2-0 victory against Everton. This shift occurred because City suffered their first defeat of the season against Aston Villa earlier in the day. Meanwhile, Tottenham Hotspur achieved a rare win at Stamford Bridge, defeating Chelsea 2-0.
amharic: አርሰናል ኤቨርተንን 2-0 በማሸነፍ በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ ከማንቸስተር ሲቲ ጋር በነጥብ እኩል መሪነት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል። ይህ የሆነው ማንቸስተር ሲቲ ቀደም ብሎ ከአስቶን ቪላ የመጀመሪያ ሽንፈቱን በማስተናገዱ ነው። በሌላ በኩል ቶተንሃም ሆትስፐር በስታምፎርድ ብሪጅ ቼልሲን 2-0 በማሸነፍ አስገራሚ ውጤት አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Arsenal Evertoniin 2-0 erga injifatee booda, kutaadhumatti Manchester City wajjin qabxii wal qixa ta’uun dursaa jira. Kun kan ta’e Manchester City guyyuma sana Aston Villaan injifatamuu isaatiin wal qabatee dha. Gama biraatiin, Tottenham Hotspur dirree Stamford Bridge irratti Chelsea 2-0 injifachuun injifannoo ajaa’ibsiisaa galmeesseera.

title: Thousands of Israelis rally against Netanyahu gov’t days before election
english: Thousands of Israelis gathered in Tel Aviv just days before a major general election to protest against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s administration. Organized by groups representing the families of hostages, the demonstrators are demanding an independent investigation into the government's security failures surrounding the October 7 attacks. With the election polls showing an extremely close contest, opposition leaders joined the crowds to call for political change and government accountability.
amharic: በእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ሊካሄድ ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀሩት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ እስራኤላውያን በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ አስተዳደር ላይ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። የታጋቾች ቤተሰቦች ባደራጁት በዚህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ፣ ተሳታፊዎቹ በጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት ወቅት ስለተፈጠረው የመንግስት የደህንነት ክፍተት ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። የምርጫው ውጤት እጅግ ተቀራራቢ እንደሚሆን በሚጠበቅበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች ህዝቡን በመቀላቀል ለውጥን እና የመንግስት ተጠያቂነትን ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Guyyoota muraasa dura filannoo biyyoolessaatti, Israa'eloonni kumaan lakkaa'aman mootummaa Ministira Muummee Beniyaamin Netanyaahuu mormuudhaan magaalaa Tel Avivitti hiriira bahaniiru. Maatiin namoota hidhatanii jiran gurmeessuudhaan qophiin kun, mootummaan guyyaa Onkololeessa 7 tarkaanfii Hamasiin dura qabaachuu qabu turee irratti qorannoo walaba ta'e akka gaggeessu gaafachaa jiru. Bu'aan filannoo sun baay'ee wal-qixxaatuu waan maluuf, hogganoonni mormituu hiriiricha irratti argamuudhaan jijjiiramaa fi gaafatamummaa mootummaa akka barbaadan ibsaniiru.

title: Riyadh airport to resume flights Sunday following closure after Houthi attacks
english: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport is set to reopen for operations this Sunday after being closed for two weeks. This temporary suspension was a security response to lethal drone and missile attacks launched by Houthi rebels from Yemen. Starting October 25, the airport will resume services, with specific terminals designated for domestic and international air travel.
amharic: የሪያድ ንጉስ ካሊድ ዓለም አቀፍ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ለሁለት ሳምንታት ከተዘጋ በኋላ እሁድ ዕለት አገልግሎቱን እንደሚጀምር አስታውቋል። አውሮፕላን ማረፊያው የተዘጋው በየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸሙ ገዳይ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ለደህንነት ሲባል ነበር። ከጥቅምት 25 ጀምሮ ተርሚናል አንድ ለሀገር ውስጥ፣ ተርሚናል ሁለት ደግሞ ለዓለም አቀፍ በረራዎች አገልግሎት ይሰጣሉ።
oromo: Buufanni xiyyaaraa idil-addunyaa King Khalid kan Riyaad, erga torban lamaaf cufamee turee booda Dilbata dhufu hojii isaa akka jalqabu beeksiseera. Cufiinsi kun kan ta'e erga haleellaan du'a hordofsiise garee Huutii kan Yaman irraa dhufuun erga raawwatamee booda nageenya eeguuf ture. Muddee 25 irraa eegalee, buufanni kun tajaajila isaa kan itti fufu yoo ta'u, tajaajila iddoo hawaa keessaa fi idil-addunyaaf tajaajila kennuuf tajaajila kennuuf adda bahee qophaa'eera.

title: Israeli artillery shells town in southern Lebanon’s Tyre district
english: Israeli military forces have begun shelling the town of al-Mansouri, located in the Tyre district of southern Lebanon. This report comes directly from Lebanon's official news agency. The situation reflects ongoing military activity in the border region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የጢሮስ ወረዳ አል-ማንሱሪ ከተማ ላይ የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባ እያካሄደ ነው። ይህ መረጃ የተገኘው ከሊባኖስ ብሔራዊ የዜና ወኪል ነው። ድርጊቱ በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን የጦር እንቅስቃሴ ያሳያል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el magaala al-Mansuurii kan kutaa biyya Liibaanoos kibbaatti argamtu irratti rukuttaa meeshaa waraana gaggeessaa jira. Odeeffannoon kun kan dhiyaate gabaasa dhaabbata oduu biyyaalessaa Liibaanoos irraayi. Gochi kun naannoo sana keessatti waraanni itti fufuun isaa kan mul'isu dha.

title: Houthis deny report that they attacked Mecca and Medina
english: Yemen's Houthi group has rejected claims made by Saudi Arabia that they launched missile strikes targeting the holy cities of Mecca and Medina. The rebels stated that their military operations are strictly aimed at Saudi oil infrastructure and defense installations. They emphasized that they openly claim responsibility whenever they carry out such attacks.
amharic: የየመኑ ሁቲ ቡድን ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ መካ እና መዲናን ኢላማ ያደረገ የሚሳይል ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል በሚል ያቀረበችውን ክስ አስተባብለዋል። ቡድኑ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽኖቹ የሳዑዲ ነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን እና ወታደራዊ ካምፖችን ብቻ ያነጣጠሩ እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል። ማንኛውም ጥቃት ሲፈጽሙም በይፋ እንደሚያሳውቁ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni Huthota Yemen, mootummaan Sa'udii magaalota qulqulluu Makkaa fi Madiinaa irratti xiyyaan rukutneera jedhee himannaa dhiyeesse kana gadi jabeessee waakkateera. Gareen kun akka ibsetti, tarkaanfiileen isaanii kan xiyyeeffatan buufataalee boba'aa fi iddoowwan waraana Sa'udii qofa irratti akka ta'e ibseera. Akkasumas, yeroo qaqqabsiisan hundatti gochicha akka ifatti beeksisan ibsaniiru.

title: Iran judiciary says chief holds rare meeting with supreme leader
english: The head of Iran's judiciary recently met with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to discuss legal matters and public welfare. This meeting is notable as the new leader has not made any public appearances since taking over after his father's death. The two officials specifically addressed strategies for fighting corruption and seeking reparations for damages caused by US and Israeli military actions.
amharic: የኢራን የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር ኃላፊ አዲሱ ጠቅላይ መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ ጋር በሕግ እና በሕዝብ ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ለመወያየት ያልተለመደ ስብሰባ አድርገዋል። አዲሱ መሪ የአባታቸው የሞት ዜና ከተሰማ በኋላ በይፋ ሳይታዩ በመቅረታቸው ይህ ስብሰባ ትኩረት ስቧል። ሁለቱ ባለስልጣናት በዋነኝነት የተወያዩት ሙስናን ስለመዋጋት እና በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ጥቃት ለደረሰው ጉዳት ካሳ ስለመጠየቅ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan mana murtii Iran, hogganaa ol’aanaa haaraa Mojtaba Khamenei waliin dhimmoota seeraa fi nageenya ummataa irratti mari'achuuf walgahii idilee hin taane tokko godhaniiru. Hogganaan kun erga abbaan isaanii du'anii booda namoota duratti waan hin mul'anneef, walgahiin kun kan adda ta'e dha. Aangeyyoonni kunneen dhimma malaammaltummaa irratti duuluu fi miidhaa tarkaanfii Amerikaa fi Israa'eliin ga'eef beenyaa gaafachuu irratti mari'ataniiru.

title: Israeli gunfire kills Palestinian man in central Gaza
english: A Palestinian man was shot and killed by Israeli military forces in the al-Musadder region of central Gaza. Medical staff at the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital confirmed they received the victim's body following the incident. No further details regarding the circumstances of the shooting have been provided.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ አል-ሙሳደር አካባቢ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተከፈተ ተኩስ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ወንድ መገደሉ ተዘግቧል። የአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል የሟቹን አስከሬን መቀበሉን አረጋግጧል። የተኩሱ መንስኤ እና ሁኔታ እስካሁን በግልጽ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Giddu-galeessa Gazaatti, naannoo al-Musadder jedhamutti waraanni Israa'el namicha Falasxiinii tokko dhukaasaan ajjeesaniiru. Hospitaalli Al-Aqsa Martyrs reeffa namicha sana fudhachuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Haalli dhukaasa kanaa fi sababni isaa ammaaf ifa hin taane.

title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes, local officials say
english: Israeli forces have begun demolishing homes, businesses, and infrastructure in Hebron following a deadly attack on soldiers at a checkpoint. Local Palestinian officials report that hundreds of people have been displaced, with further demolitions expected as the military restricts movement in the area. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu authorized the destruction of properties linked to the attackers and surrounding neighborhoods as part of a wider security crackdown.
amharic: በኬክሮን በተፈጠረ የሁለት እስራኤላውያን ወታደሮች መገደል ተከትሎ፣ የእስራኤል ጦር በከተማዋ በሚገኙ ቤቶች እና ንግድ ቤቶች ላይ የፈረሳ እርምጃ ወስዷል። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ እርምጃ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ከመኖሪያቸው ያፈናቀለ ሲሆን የከተማዋ እንቅስቃሴም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተገድቧል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ለጥቃቱ ተጠያቂ ናቸው ያሏቸውን ግለሰቦች አካባቢዎች ለማፍረስ ማዘዛቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ሌሎችም ቤቶች ለፈረሳ እንደሚዳረጉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa’el duula waraanaan walqabatee magaalaa Heebroon keessatti mana jireenyaa fi bakka daldalaa hedduu diiguun namoota dhibbaan lakkaa’aman buqqisee jira. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame loltoonni Israa’el lama iddoo qormaataatti ajjeefamuu isaanii hordofee dha. Bulchaan magaalaa Heebroon akka jedhanitti, namoonni kuma tokkoo ol ta’an manneen isaanii irraa kan buqqifaman yoo ta’u, gandoota biroo keessattis diigamtiin ni jiraata jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Thousands gather at new Albanian antigovernment rally
english: Thousands of protesters clashed with police in Tirana, Albania, during a large demonstration demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama. The unrest, which resulted in over 300 injuries, was driven by public frustration over high living costs, education issues, and government corruption. While the Prime Minister has called for dialogue, protesters rejected his gestures and continue to demand systemic change in the country.
amharic: በአልባኒያ ዋና ከተማ ቲራና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኤዲ ራማ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ በመጠየቅ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። ከ300 በላይ ሰዎችን ያቆሰለው ይህ ተቃውሞ፣ በዋናነት የተነሳው በኑሮ ውድነት፣ በትምህርት ጥራት ማነስ እና በመንግስት ሙስና ምክንያት ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ለውይይት ጥሪ ቢያቀርቡም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ጥሪውን ውድቅ በማድረግ አገሪቱ መሰረታዊ ለውጥ እንድታደርግ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Albaniyaa Tiraanaatti, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman Muummee Ministiraa Edi Raamaan aangoo akka gad-lisan gaafachuun poolisii wajjin walitti bu'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa namoota 300 ol miidhe kana kan kaase, gatii jireenyaa ol ka'uu, hanqina barnootaa fi malaammaltuu mootummaa irratti mufachuu dha. Muummee Ministirichaa mariif waamicha godhanis, hiriirtonni waamicha sana fudhachuu diduun jijjiirama bu'uuraa biyyattii keessatti akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Trump says he may move White House press corps to new location
english: President Donald Trump has suggested he might relocate the White House press corps to a different area, away from their current briefing room. While he denied rumors that he would replace the room with a historic swimming pool, he expressed a desire to move journalists to a space he considers less disruptive. This proposal follows ongoing tensions between the President and the media, characterized by verbal confrontations and legal battles over reporter access to the White House.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኋይት ሀውስ ጋዜጠኞችን ከአሁኑ የፕሬስ ክፍል ወደ ሌላ ቦታ ለማዛወር ማቀዳቸውን ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጋዜጠኞችን አስወጥተው ታሪካዊ መዋኛ ገንዳ ለመስራት ማቀዳቸውን ቢክዱም፣ ጋዜጠኞቹን ይበልጥ ተስማሚ ወደሆነ ሌላ ቦታ ለማንቀሳቀስ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል። ይህ ውጥን በፕሬዚዳንቱ እና በጋዜጠኞች መካከል ያለው አለመግባባት እየተባባሰ በመጣበት ወቅት የመጣ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱ ወገኖች በጋዜጠኞች የኋይት ሀውስ የመግባት መብት ዙሪያ በተደጋጋሚ ሲጋጩ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp gareen gaazexeessitoota Waayit Haawsii (White House) bakka amma jiran irraa gara bakka biraatti akka geessan dubbataniiru. Odeeffannoon kutaa gaazexeessitootaa diiganii iddoo daakuu bishaanii (swimming pool) durii deebisanii ijaaruuf qaban kijiba jechuun haalanis, gaazexeessitoota gara bakka itti fayyadamuuf haalaan mijataa ta'eetti jijjiiruuf yaadachuu mirkaneessaniiru. Yaanni kun walitti bu'iinsa pirezidaantichaafi midiyaa gidduu jiru jabaataa deemuu wajjin walqabatee kan dhufe yoo ta'u, gaazexeessitoonni mana mootummaa keessa seenanii gabaasuuf mirga qabaachuu fi dhabuu irratti walmormaa jiru.

title: About 25,000 rally in Madrid in support of Spain’s state pension scheme
english: Around 25,000 protesters marched in Madrid to demand the protection and strengthening of Spain's public pension system ahead of next month's general election. Demonstrators are calling for benefits to remain tied to inflation and for an end to the gender-based pay gap in retirement income. Concerns regarding the system's sustainability stem from demographic shifts and political uncertainty, as citizens seek to guarantee dignified support for retirees regardless of the election outcome.
amharic: በመጪው ወር በሚካሄደው ጠቅላላ ምርጫ ዋዜማ፣ በስፔን የጡረታ አበል ስርዓት ላይ ለውጥ እንዳይመጣ በመጠየቅ ወደ 25,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች በማድሪድ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የጡረታ ክፍያ ከዋጋ ግሽበት ጋር ተያይዞ እንዲቀጥል እና በጡረተኞች መካከል ያለው የሥርዓተ-ፆታ የገቢ ልዩነት እንዲወገድ ይፈልጋሉ። የሕዝብ ቁጥር እድገት እና የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት የጡረታ ስርዓቱን አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል የሚል ስጋት ስላላቸው፣ መንግስት የጡረተኞችን መብት እንዲያረጋግጥ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Maadriiditti namoonni kuma 25 ol ta'an sirni kaffaltii sooramaa biyyattii akka eegamuuf hiriira bahaniiru. Hiriirtonni kunneen kaffaltiin sooramaa gatii meeshaan dabaluu waliin akka wal-qabatuufi wal-qixxummaan koorniyaa akka kabajamu gaafataniiru. Filannoo dhufu irratti hundaa'uun sirni sooramaa laaffachuu danda'a kan jedhu sodaan jiraatus, hiriirtonni kunneen soorattoonni kabajaan akka jiraataniif mootummaan dirqama isaa akka bahu dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: Tigray’s Liberation Must End in Freedom
english: Tigrayan nationalism has successfully mobilized the population for survival but has failed to transition into a stable system of self-governance. While the region has endured immense suffering and conflict, the current leadership relies on military resilience and factional control rather than building inclusive, law-based political institutions. To secure a sustainable future, Tigray must move beyond mere liberation and focus on establishing a durable democratic order that serves its citizens.
amharic: የትግራይ ብሄርተኝነት ህዝብን ለህልውና በማስተባበር ረገድ ስኬታማ ቢሆንም፣ ዘላቂ የሆነ የመስተዳድር ስርዓት በመገንባት ረገድ ግን ክፍተት አሳይቷል። ክልሉ ከፍተኛ ስቃይና ጦርነት ቢያስተናግድም፣ የአሁኑ አመራር በህግ የበላይነት ላይ የተመሰረቱ ተቋማትን ከመገንባት ይልቅ በወታደራዊ አቅምና በቡድን ፍላጎት ላይ ተወስኗል። ዘላቂ ሰላም እና ነፃነት ለማምጣት ትግራይ ከነፃነት ትግል አልፋ በህዝብ ፍላጎት የሚመራ ስርዓት መዘርጋት ይኖርባታል።
oromo: Biyya-oollummaan Tigraay uummata isaanii biyya oolchuuf waan gaariitti sochoosuun danda'us, sirna bulchiinsa dhaabbataawaa ta'e diriirsuu irratti garuu dadhabina qaba. Naannoon sun waraanaa fi dararama cimaa darbe keessa erga darbee booda, hoogganoonni amma jiran kan xiyyeeffatan bulchiinsa seeraa fi dhaabbataawaa ijaaruu mannaa, humna waraanaa fi fedhii garee irratti qofa ta'eera. Fuulduratti nagaa fi bilisummaa dhugaa gonfachuuf, Tigraay adeemsa bilisummaa qofa irratti osoo hin taane, sirna uummataan buluu fi seeraan hogganamu ijaaruu irratti xiyyeeffachuu qabdi.

title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
english: Vanessa Trump, the former wife of Donald Trump Jr., has announced she is cancer-free six months after being diagnosed with breast cancer. She shared the news in a video alongside her daughter, Kai, to coincide with Breast Cancer Awareness Month. The pair plans to release a longer discussion soon to raise awareness about the importance of early detection and prevention.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጁኒየር የቀድሞ ሚስት ቫኔሳ ትራምፕ፣ የጡት ካንሰር እንዳለባት ከተረጋገጠ ከስድስት ወራት በኋላ ከበሽታው ሙሉ በሙሉ መዳኗን አስታውቃለች። ይህንን ዜና ያካፈለችው የጡት ካንሰር ግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ ወርን ምክንያት በማድረግ ከልጇ ከካይ ጋር በመሆን ነው። ሁለቱም የካንሰር መከላከያ መንገዶችን እና ቀደም ብሎ የመመርመርን አስፈላጊነት የሚያብራራ ዝርዝር መረጃ በቅርቡ ይፋ እንደሚያደርጉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hiriyaan gaa'elaa duraanii Donald Trump Jr., Vanessa Trump, erga dhukkubni kaansarii harmaa irratti argamee ji'a jaha booda fayyuu ishee beeksisiteetti. Odeeffannoo kana kan qooddatte ilmoo ishee Kai waliin ta'uun, ji'a hubannoo kaansarii harmaa ilaalchisee dha. Lamaanuu waa'ee ittisaa fi dursanii dhukkubicha beekuun fayyadamummaa qabu irratti marii bal'aa fuulduratti akka dhiheessan beeksisaniiru.

title: More than 2,000 forced from homes in Hebron amid Israel’s West Bank raids
english: Following a deadly attack that killed two Israeli soldiers, Israel has placed the occupied West Bank under a full lockdown. In Hebron, over 2,000 Palestinians were abruptly forced out of their homes by the military, while dozens of others were arrested during widespread raids across the region. The Palestinian Authority has condemned these actions as collective punishment and is calling for urgent international intervention to protect the displaced residents.
amharic: ሁለት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ እስራኤል በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ላይ አጠቃላይ የቤት ውስጥ እስር አውጃለች። በሄብሮን ከተማ ብቻ ከ2,000 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ የተደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በሌሎች የክልሉ አካባቢዎችም በርካታ እስሮች ተፈጽመዋል። የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር እነዚህን ድርጊቶች የጋራ ቅጣት በማለት በመውቀስ፣ የተፈናቀሉትን ነዋሪዎች ለመጠበቅ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el loltoota ishee lama erga du'anii booda, naannoo West Bank guutummaatti cuftee jira. Magaalaa Hebron keessatti namoonni Falisxeemii 2,000 ol ta'an dirqamaan manaa baafamanii jiru, akkasumas naannichatti duula waraanaa bal'aan gaggeeffamee namoonni hedduun hidhamanii jiru. Bulchiinsi Falisxeemii tarkaanfii kana adabbii waloo jechuun balaaleffachuu isaanii fi uummata buqqa'e kana gargaaruuf hawaasni addunyaa akka gidduu galu gaafatanii jiru.

title: Brazil’s Lula and Bolsonaro about even ahead of election run-off: Poll
english: Brazil's upcoming presidential runoff election shows a very tight race between incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro. Recent polls indicate that both candidates have nearly identical levels of public support as they head into the final vote. The two rivals have spent the campaign debating critical issues like the economy, infrastructure, and crime to sway undecided voters.
amharic: የብራዚል ፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሁለተኛ ዙር በፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና በሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ መካከል እጅግ ተቀራራቢ ፉክክር እንደሚደረግበት ይጠበቃል። የቅርብ ጊዜ የሕዝብ አስተያየት ውጤቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ሁለቱም እጩዎች ተቀራራቢ ድጋፍ አላቸው። ተቀናቃኞቹ በኢኮኖሚ፣ በመሠረተ ልማት እና በወንጀል ጉዳዮች ላይ በመከራከር የመጨረሻውን የምርጫ ውጤት ወደራሳቸው ለማዘንበል እየጣሩ ነው።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidantummaa biyya Brazil marsaa lammaffaa irratti, pirezidant Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva fi senatar Flavio Bolsonaro gidduutti dorgommiin cimaan akka jiru himameera. Qorannoon sagalee uummataa akka agarsiisutti, lamaanuu deeggarsa wal-qixa ta'e qabu. Dorgomtoonni kunneen mariiwwan isaanii irratti dhimmoota diinagdee, bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi yakka irratti xiyyeeffachuun, filattoota amansiisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Security forces deploy as Milan braces for another day of protests
english: Italian authorities have deployed 500 soldiers to Milan as the city prepares for new demonstrations against the government's economic policies and rising living costs. These protests follow recent clashes and looting, prompting police to conduct widespread raids and investigations into suspected rioters. While some organizers are calling for peaceful dissent, the government has ramped up security measures to prevent further unrest.
amharic: የጣሊያን መንግስት በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና በኑሮ ውድነት ላይ የሚደረጉ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎችን ለመቆጣጠር 500 ወታደሮችን ወደ ሚላን ከተማ ልኳል። ባለፈው ሳምንት በተከሰተው ረብሻ እና ዘረፋ ሳቢያ ፖሊስ ተጠርጣሪዎችን ለማደን በበርካታ ከተሞች የፍተሻ ዘመቻዎችን አካሂዷል። አንዳንዶቹ አዘጋጆች ሰልፉ በሰላማዊ መንገድ እንዲካሄድ ጥሪ እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ባለስልጣናት ተጨማሪ ሁከት እንዳይፈጠር ጥብቅ የፀጥታ እርምጃዎችን ወስደዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Xaaliyaanii rakkoo dinagdee fi gatii jireenyaa dabale irratti hiriira mormii godhamu ittisuuf loltoota 500 gara magaalaa Miilaanitti ergeera. Torban darbe hiriira irratti miidhaa fi saamichi waan tureef, poolisiin shakkamtoota sakatta'uuf magaalota hedduu keessatti qorannoo geggeessaa jira. Gurmeessitoonni tokko tokko hiriirichi nagaa akka ta'u gaafatanis, mootummaan jeequmsa dabalataa ittisuuf eegumsa cimaa gochaa jira.

title: Why Israeli tourists and investors are unsettling Cypriots
english: Cyprus is seeing a significant rise in Israeli tourism and business investment, which has brought new economic activity to the country. However, many local residents are concerned that this influx is negatively impacting the local economy and causing community displacement. Some Cypriots also feel that the strong Israeli presence is bringing unwanted political tensions into their neighborhoods.
amharic: ቆጵሮስ በእስራኤላውያን ቱሪስቶች እና ባለሀብቶች ቁጥር መጨመር ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ለውጦች እያስተናገደች ትገኛለች። ምንም እንኳን ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጠቀሜታ ቢኖረውም፣ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ንግዳቸው እንደተጎዳ እና ከቀያቸው እየተፈናቀሉ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ ቅሬታቸውን እያሰሙ ነው። በተጨማሪም የዚህ ተፅዕኖ መስፋፋት በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ ያልተፈለገ የፖለቲካ ውጥረትን እየፈጠረ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Qopros keessatti lakkoofsi tuuristotaa fi invastaroota Israa'el dabalaa dhufuun isaa jijjiirama guddaa fidaa jira. Kun carraa dinagdee kan uumu ta'us, jiraattonni naannichaa gabaan isaanii miidhamuu fi manaa fi qe'ee isaaniirraa buqqa'aa akka jiran himuun yaaddoo ibsachaa jiru. Akkasumas, dhiibbaan Israa'el kun naannichatti waldhabdee siyaasaa kan hin barbaadamne uumaa akka jiru ibsameera.

title: Full lockdown of occupied West Bank begins
english: The Israeli military has implemented a complete lockdown across the West Bank, closing all checkpoints and border crossings for Palestinians. As part of these operations, approximately 200 Palestinian families have been displaced from their homes in Hebron. These measures mark a significant escalation in military activity throughout the occupied territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በዌስት ባንክ ሙሉ የመውጫና የመግቢያ ዘግያ መተግበሩን አስታውቋል፤ በዚህም መሰረት በክልሉ የሚገኙ ሁሉም የፍተሻ ጣቢያዎችና ድንበሮች ለፍልስጤማውያን ተዘግተዋል። በዚሁ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ምክንያት ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ከሄብሮን ከተማ እንዲለቁ ተደርገዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በተያዘው የፍልስጤም ግዛት ውስጥ ያለውን የወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ከፍ ያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el naannoo Daangaa Dhihaa (West Bank) guutummaatti cufuun, iddoowwan qorannoo fi daangawwan hunda namoota Falasxiin irratti cufuu isaa ibseera. Hojiwwan waraanaa kanaan walqabatee, maatiin Falasxiin 200 ta'an magaalaa Heebroon keessaa akka gadhiisan dirqisiifamaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun naannoo qabame kana keessatti sochiin waraanaa daran akka jabaatu godheera.

title: Yemen's Houthis say they attacked Saudi oil facilities, airports
english: Yemen's Houthi group claimed responsibility for a series of drone and missile attacks targeting major oil facilities and airports across Saudi Arabia on Saturday. The targeted locations reportedly included refineries in Yanbu and Rabigh, alongside several international airports and a military base. As of now, Saudi officials have not provided any official response or confirmation regarding these strikes.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂ ቡድን ቅዳሜ ዕለት በሳዑዲ አረቢያ በሚገኙ ዋና ዋና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች እና አየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። ቡድኑ በጥቃቱ የያንቡ እና የራቢግ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን እንዲሁም በርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ አየር ማረፊያዎችን እና ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎችን ኢላማ ማድረጉን ገልጿል። የሳዑዲ ባለሥልጣናት እስካሁን ስለ ጥቃቱ የሰጡት ማረጋገጫ ወይም መግለጫ የለም።
oromo: gareen Houthi kan Yemen, sambata darbe buufataalee boba’aa fi dirree xiyyaraa Sa’udii Arabiyaa gurguddoo irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa beeksiseera. Haleellaa kana keessatti rafinarawwan boba’aa Yanbuu fi Raabiigh, akkasumas dirreen xiyyaraa idil-addunyaa fi buufataalee waraanaa miidhamuu isaanii gareen kun ibseera. Aangeyyoonni Sa’udii hanga ammaatti waa’ee haleellaa kanaa ilaalchisee ibsa kenname hin qaban.
